title: Dispatch Minutes on ClearPath Onsite Visits
content:
How the minutes of the onsite visit amount of a ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket are billed follows the dispatch rule, which counts the calendar days from the ticket's opening to its resolution, both as recorded in the ticket history.

(a) A visit resolved the same day the ticket was opened bills the greater of the recorded minutes plus 30 minutes and 120 minutes.

(b) A visit resolved the next day bills the recorded minutes plus 30 minutes.

(c) A visit resolved later bills the recorded minutes.

**Input, judgement, output (hypothetical visits).**

| Opened | Resolved | Recorded minutes | Minutes billed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tuesday 09:10 | Tuesday 15:40 | 60 | the greater of 90 and 120: 120 |
| Tuesday 09:10 | Tuesday 16:00 | 120 | the greater of 150 and 120: 150 |
| Tuesday 16:30 | Wednesday 10:00 | 60 | 90 |
| Tuesday 16:30 | Thursday 10:00 | 60 | 60 |

The minutes billed are divided by 60 to give the hours priced at the onsite hourly rate.
